quest.0A89941FEB91D334.quest_desc: &#a855f7Universium&r, a mix of &#d946efmagic&r and &#00d2fftechnology&r, so powerful, yet, there is something &#7c3aedhiding&r behind it, something &#f43f5emore&r

quest.0A94986A4230D076.quest_subtitle: &#38bdf86 June XXXX&r, &#fbbf24Day 1265&r, someone is &#e11d48watching me&r, someone wants to &#dc2626get rid of me&r
quest.0C2CD9900AA92976.quest_desc: &#eab308Bees&r are another powerful way to farm &#22c55ematerials&r, they have a much &#f97316harder start&r, but it &#10b981pays out&r
quest.0D8C28070FAC998F.quest_desc: One of the first &#00d2ffmultiblocks&r you can make, this little one needs a few &#845336mud blocks&r, but allows to get &#f59e0balloys&r at a much &#22c55efaster rate&r
quest.0E07814D7267F671.quest_desc: &#10b981Phytos&r allows to farm &#d946efMystical Agriculture&r seeds at a much &#22c55efaster pace&r than farmlands, and even includes some &#38bdf8lag reduction&r
quest.13AA8A73A923DDB4.quest_desc: First, we will need a &#3b82f6base&r, so find a place where you want to stay, a &#78716ccave&r might be a good idea if you closed one
quest.14384D2E8873E4F2.quest_desc: &#f59e0bModularium&r is a unique material, flexible and sturdy enough to fit in some &#00d2ffmachine&r, able to generate some &#64748bcasing&r strong enough for many uses.
quest.144B221805C7C820.quest_desc: We will start with the &#e0e0e0basic ingots&r, these can be obtained from &#f59e0bmining&r, as well as other resources, like &#38bdf8gems&r, make sure to have a good amount of these
quest.144B221805C7C820.title: &#38bdf8Basic Materials&r
quest.1D93FE453E81F63E.quest_desc: The &#ef4444Nether&r is an important dimension, but you won't need to visit it for a long time, just to gather some &#f59e0bmaterials&r.
Most of the stuff that is found on it can be gathered &#22c55eother ways&r
quest.1D93FE453E81F63E.title: &#ef4444Visit The Nether&r
quest.2533EC424651E685.quest_desc: There are a few ways to farm &#22c55etrees&r without planting them in-world.
This &#00d2ffmultiblock&r uses &#f59e0bpower&r, some &#38bdf8water&r and the &#84cc16sapling&r to get some logs back
quest.2BDE5C2FAFB2AC76.quest_desc: This little &#00d2ffmultiblock&r allows to farm some &#e0e0e0basic materials&r for building your base.
To start the machine, you need the &#f59e0bblock&r you want to farm 2 blocks below the &#3b82f6controller&r.

quest.30D20E731E280641.quest_desc: Time to mine some &#a855f7obsidian&r, here is a tip: a &#f59e0bForce Pickaxe&r acts as a &#38bdf8diamond pickaxe&r, saving you some of those early resources
quest.30D20E731E280641.title: &#a855f7Obsidian&r
quest.31E1FB302F37D49E.quest_desc: Seems like using my old &#ef4444fission reactor&r wasn't efficient at all, I can use a better version to get more &#f59e0bpower&r out and even some &#a855f7anomalies&r.
Is this the &#38bdf8Anomalous Magnetic Dipole Moment&r of muons? Maybe, we can't know

I should use it to get some &#e0e0e0stronger ingots&r
quest.3C610251DCF2FA0F.quest_desc: There are 4 main mods that can manage your storages: &#00d2ffRefined Storage&r, &#a855f7Applied Energistics&r, &#f59e0bSophisticated Chests&r and &#22c55eFunctional Storage&r.

quest.3CB9E3F955F8D6F0.quest_desc: The &#7c3aedVoid&r and the &#fbbf24Sun&r, 2 opposite forces, what could go wrong
quest.3DEC7AE475013992.quest_desc: I've got a revelation, a &#f59e0bforge&r so powerful to get a piece of the &#a855f7Universe&r in my hands
quest.3E9E501970A06220.quest_desc: &#d946efBuds&r are also a great alternative, they have a much smaller number of options, but when they have one, you should &#22c55echoose them&r
quest.3EAC603BD09EC99C.quest_desc: &#38bdf8Gravity&r is a strong force of nature, yet delicate. Give too much force and it will rip &#a855f7space-time&r itself.
I can use this to my advantage, but I should be careful when near the &#7c3aedblack hole&r and my items
quest.40B2A5F2F7C8994F.quest_desc: &#38bdf8Fishes&r are a good source of food, but there is also something &#d946efhidden&r in the water
quest.43F1AA4B7C89E714.quest_desc: You don't actually need to find a blaze to get &#f97316blaze rods&r!
You can use multiple other ways to gather them, or make them
Although a &#ef4444spawner&r with a blaze would be perfect
quest.472E9DA6FDF20B12.quest_desc: And that's all for now, &#38bdf8stay tuned&r for more!
quest.47F03F90D5F2CD8C.quest_desc: &#a855f7Hostile Neural Networks&r is another mod that allows to mass collect mob drops, the only problem is that there are tons of mobs.
So instead of building tons of loot fabricators, you only need to do &#00d2ff1 multiblock&r
quest.4B68946D3145AED0.quest_desc: &#a855f7Endermen&r, while rare in the Overworld, are common in &#ef4444The Nether&r, especially in &#0d9488Warped Forests&r, but make sure to have good &#f59e0barmor&r to defeat them
quest.50AC11629F325C60.quest_desc: The &#a855f7Universe&r itself, there is something deeper than the entity that's &#ef4444watching me&r, something &#f59e0bmore powerful&r
quest.50DE8A7E8A444305.quest_desc: With the influx of &#f59e0bresources&r, my old methods stay behind, so we need to bring a &#00d2ffmachine&r faster than before, yet linked to &#a855f7all dimensions&r
quest.5104DB4212EB337E.quest_desc: Time to launch some material to &#a855f7space&r, &#38bdf8Etherium ingots&r can be converted to &#f43f5eStellarium&r if I aim at the &#fbbf24Sun&r, and &#64748bReplica ingots&r can simulate the deep darkness of Space.
There seems to be some species that can interact with &#f43f5eStellarium&r
quest.5381C2B4F6E953D4.quest_desc: &#f59e0bPower&r is another issue in the long run, since you will need tons of it. For now, you can use some &#fbbf24solar&r or &#00d2ffMekanism&r or similar to generate it.
Later on, you can do other setups to get them
quest.554B4EF287F6CAE5.quest_desc: And with great resources, I need to improve the &#f59e0bfurnaces&r.
It's even faster than my &#7c3aednetherite furnaces&r
quest.5591F72EFC4C39BA.quest_desc: Time to save your &#333333coal&r! This &#f59e0bfurnace&r can replace up to 6 furnaces, taking less time than those 6 and needing &#22c55eno fuel at all&r to work!
quest.59676DE2B5344C49.quest_desc: &#475569Shadowsteel&r can only be made by 2 means: this &#00d2ffmachine&r and using the crafting table in dust form.
Right now, you can only make this using this machine, so I would &#22c55epassive&r it as soon as you can
quest.5AEC0BB5A048AC98.quest_desc: Your mission is making the &#d946efCatalyst&r, from &#a855f7Catalyst Core&r. Right now, you can't do that, but you can get close to it.
This modpack relies on &#00d2ffmultiblocks&r for progression; these machines are based on multiple blocks, there is a whole chapter about them!
quest.5B3AA86DE7CF8223.quest_desc: Converts some of your excess &#f59e0bplates&r and &#e0e0e0foils&r back to &#a855f7dust form&r
It has some mod compatibility, so check them out!
quest.6068BEE06CB76723.quest_desc: &#ef4444Blood&r is an impulse to life, but also has some &#9f1239corruption&r to it. While minor, it can make some gems into a &#ef4444blood version&r
quest.612E2B13CB930F93.quest_desc: Time to upgrade your mining equipment with this little tool: it can mine in a &#f59e0b3x3 area&r, and with &#38bdf8Ultimine&r and a good food supply, you can mine &#22c55efaster than ever&r
quest.614E763FEFBB72DC.quest_desc: At this point, you probably are going to need lots of &#f59e0bresources&r for your setups, there are 2 main ways to do this: &#22c55eresource generation&r or &#38bdf8mining&r.
- &#22c55eResource generation&r means any mod that generates resources from the &#7c3aedvoid&r or by using a medium, like &#84cc16plants&r
- &#38bdf8Mining&r, there is a whole &#fbbf24mining dimension&r meant for that; you can mine anything from the overworld, the nether, and the end
Both can scale to the endgame, so you won't need to worry about it, but at one point or another you should move to the first method for simple logistics and avoiding &#ef4444lag&r
quest.662618872CD26CA2.quest_desc: &#a855f7Nebulas&r contained in a strong glass, able to resist the impact of a dying star's core.
But with a new death, there are 2 new lives—that seems to be the case here, able to generate some &#38bdf8gems&r in the process, some even attuned to the &#7c3aedvoid&r
quest.6953868916F81BE6.quest_desc: Unlike other versions, this reduces time by &#22c55e1/4&r, and you can send more items at the same time. But you can't reuse the hatches; you have to get a &#00d2ffbigger version&r
quest.6C80DF67224B3D91.quest_desc: Improved version of the &#00d2ffIgneous Extruder&r, make sure to have tons of space
quest.6D9E9DBF81C0842F.quest_desc: &#84cc16Crops&r are also a harder way to farm materials in mass without in-world farming.
Under ideal conditions, some plants are able to produce &#22c55emore&r than their natural counterpart
quest.736E61A79AF167DF.quest_desc: &#06b6d4Eternity&r, an infinite amount of time, yet I can't touch it, it's flying around me
quest.74F60A56B96706B6.quest_desc: &#22c55eAutomation&r is essential to any kind of modpack; even moving items from point A to B is a lot less effort for you.
There are a few mods that can do this, faster or slower, but it will free you. &#a855f7AE2&r and &#00d2ffRS&r will make this the easiest of all
quest.7693727CE16BBC6C.quest_desc: Well, it seems like there are places where neither methods can go to generate some resources, but there seems to be a &#00d2ffmultiblock&r that can do that
quest.76EFD340D2390FC3.quest_desc: Using &#a855f7souls&r, you can even &#22c55espeed up&r the recipe time
quest.7CE96B794E16F8FF.quest_desc: If you haven't gone to &#a855f7The End&r, there are a few ways to generate your first end stone, for example, using &#00d2ffHostile Neural Networks&r or &#d946efArs Nouveau&r.

quest.7E1D3C5620943356.quest_desc: &#00d2ffExtruders&r allow a much faster way to get &#f59e0bplates&r, and even give some of the original material back in &#a855f7dust form&r when they can
quest.7EF4F236ABF01FAB.quest_desc: &#fbbf24Light&r and &#7c3aedDarkness&r, 2 opposite elements, yet they complement each other.

quest.7FB083690C070E1B.quest_desc: &#38bdf8Crystals&r can be used to gather materials from different parts of the &#a855f7universe&r in an instant, as if they were waiting for me
